No merge or push.","Description":["All seven NinjaTrader usecase_create calls hit CreateUseCaseCommandHandler.SaveChanges and returned a generic Entity Framework persistence message with no UseCases rows created. The handler inserts UseCaseEntity with a required FK to Workspaces, but unlike requirements ingest it never ensures a Workspaces parent row for the resolved workspace path (tests seed that row first). Any DbUpdateException is swallowed as Result.Failure(ex.Message), so SerializeResult cannot classify it as not_found/validation/conflict and McpToolErrors never sees the exception or the inner SQLite/FK/schema cause.","Triage group: triage-group-0c1b4fed35c7c183","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- A valid usecase_create against a registered workspace path that has no pre-seeded Workspaces row either auto-creates that parent row and persists the use case, or returns a classified not_found/validation error that names the missing workspace instead of a raw EF save message.","- A successful usecase_create returns a detail payload with a positive useCaseId, and usecase_list for that workspace includes the new title.","- When SaveChanges throws DbUpdateException, the tool/API error includes a classified code and the inner provider message rather than only 'An error occurred while saving the entity changes. See the inner exception for details.'","- Existing create-success tests stay green; a regression test covers create without a pre-seeded Workspaces row and covers classified persistence-failure output.","Implementation notes:","- Primary path: CreateUseCaseCommandHandler.HandleAsync in src/McpServer.Services/UseCases/Commands/CreateUseCaseCommand.cs. First SaveChanges inserts UseCaseEntity; catch (Exception ex) returns Result.Failure(ex.Message, ex) and drops the inner provider error.","- UseCaseEntity is configured with a required FK to WorkspaceEntity (McpDbContext UseCaseEntity mapping, Restrict). ResolveWorkspaceId only overrides CurrentWorkspaceId; it does not insert a Workspaces row. Model seed only includes WorkspaceId ''. RequirementsDatabaseDocumentService.EnsureWorkspaceRowAsync already upserts the parent row.","- Mirror EnsureWorkspaceRowAsync (or equivalent) in CreateUseCaseCommandHandler and CreateUseCaseFromFrCommandHandler before the first UseCases insert.","- Classify DbUpdateException (missing parent, constraint, missing table) with UseCaseResultCodes plus inner exception text. FwhMcpTools.UseCases.SerializeResult only strips not_found/validation/conflict prefixes; swallowed Result failures never reach McpToolErrors.","- Do not treat this as backend_unavailable unless StorageBackendUnavailability.IsBackendUnavailable is actually true. Schema drift (missing UseCases table) is a secondary possibility if migrations were not applied; the same unclassified wrapper would hide that too."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":"Implementation through local follow-up a404937890cb13b06480b4bdcc7802f3de38e506 now adds immutable creation-response receipts, stable deepest-ancestor physical workspace identity, a CWD-invariant GraphRAG global lock, exact SQLite FR trigger semantics, and deterministic provider lock-path cancellation coverage.","Remaining":"Fifth adversarial findings remediated in c91630fc4e9dc6db5a97b866b7dae01b27ba8c15: migrated receipts and runtime replay now derive receipt identity from the stored WorkspacePath while retaining opaque WorkspaceId foreign keys; initial success, replay, and commit-ambiguity recovery return the same actor-populated DTO without a post-save read; workspace lookup is asynchronous/token-aware and SQLite lock acquisition is bounded/cancellable; the shared path policy preserves Windows/UNC/device roots, collapses cross-platform dot segments, resolves existing symlink/junction/mapped-drive aliases physically, and remains lexical for nonexistent/non-native paths; federation stores canonical filesystem paths separately from opaque SHA workspace IDs and uses ordinal opaque-ID comparisons; SQLite, SQL Server LocalDB, and PostgreSQL have real contention, rollback, ambiguity, cancellation, deletion-race, migration-replay, and full-payload evidence.
